editorialSummary.heading: A January 6 return and five modified instructional days
paragraphs: The district calendar lists Monday, August 10, 2026, as the first student day for schools in Vero Beach, Sebastian and Fellsmere. Elementary and K–8 orientations were scheduled for August 5, middle school orientation for August 6 and high school orientation for August 7. Open houses in September and parent-teacher conference nights in October also take place on different dates by school level. Families with children at more than one school may have separate events to attend.

Students have two separate Fridays off in October: October 23, following conference nights, and October 30, for teacher professional learning. Classes are scheduled October 26–29 in between, so there is no weeklong fall break. Another round of conference nights takes place February 9–11, followed by a student-free Friday on February 12 and Presidents’ Day on Monday, February 15.

Thanksgiving break runs November 23–27. The district lists Winter Break from December 21 through January 1, but January 4 and 5 are also student-free, so classes do not resume until Wednesday, January 6. Spring break is March 22–26, with a scheduled March 29 return.

Students still attend on the five modified instructional days, December 17–18 and May 26–28. The Parent Guide lists normally shortened dismissal hours, although emergency make-up needs may change them. May 28 is also the last student day.
highlights: First student day: August 10, 2026; last student day: May 28, 2027.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Indian River County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Monday, August 10, 2026, is the first day of school for students. Elementary and K–8, middle, and high school orientations take place on separate dates during the preceding week.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Indian River County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027, is the last student day and the end of the fourth grading quarter. It is a modified instructional day, so students attend on an adjusted schedule. Confirm the dismissal time with your school.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Indian River County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. With both weekends, students are away from regular classes March 20–28 and are scheduled to return Monday, March 29. March 15–19 remains a regular school week.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Indian River County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students have November 23–27, 2026, off for Thanksgiving break. Including the weekends, that gives them November 21–29 away from regular classes. School is scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break for the 2026–2027 school year?
faqs.answer: The district lists Winter Break from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 and 5 are also student-free days. Including weekends, students are away from regular classes December 19–January 5.

faqs.question: When do Indian River County students return from winter break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. January 4 is an optional teacher day, and January 5 is for teacher planning and professional learning. Students have no classes on either date.

faqs.question: Which dates are modified instructional days in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The five dates are December 17 and 18, 2026, and May 26, 27 and 28, 2027. All five count as student attendance days. December 18 ends the second quarter, and May 28 is the last day of school.

faqs.question: Does a modified instructional day mean students have no school?
faqs.answer: No. Students attend school on modified instructional days. The 2026–2027 Parent Guide lists normally shortened hours for elementary, middle/K–8 and high schools, but the district calendar says dismissal may be adjusted if emergency make-up time is needed.

faqs.question: What time is dismissal on modified instructional days?
faqs.answer: The 2026–2027 Parent Guide lists normal modified-day dismissal at 1:50 p.m. for elementary schools, 1:00 p.m. for middle and K–8 schools, and 12:20 p.m. for high schools. These times are Eastern Time and may change if emergency make-up time is needed. IR Prep and Wabasso School do not have modified-day dismissal times listed in that guide.

faqs.question: What are regular school hours in Indian River County for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools run from 9:00 a.m. to 3:40 p.m.; middle and K–8 schools from 8:10 a.m. to 2:51 p.m.; and high schools from 7:20 a.m. to 2:07 p.m. All times are Eastern. IR Prep and Wabasso School have separate schedules.

faqs.question: Can hurricane make-up days change the school calendar or dismissal times?
faqs.answer: Yes, changes are possible if emergency make-up time is needed. The district calendar specifically notes that dismissal on modified instructional days depends on emergency make-up needs. It does not identify fixed hurricane make-up holidays. Follow district announcements for any actual change.

faqs.question: Is there a full fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Students are off Friday, October 23, because of conferences and Friday, October 30, for staff professional learning. October 26–29 remain scheduled school days, so the two Fridays do not form a weeklong fall break.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday, March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday falls during spring break, which runs March 22–26, 2027. The district calendar lists this as part of Spring Break rather than a separate Good Friday holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school on Easter Monday, March 29, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, March 29, is the scheduled return to school after spring break. The district calendar does not list Easter Monday as an additional day off.

faqs.question: Why do students have a four-day weekend in February 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, February 12, is a no-school day due to parent-teacher conferences, and Monday, February 15, is Presidents’ Day. Combined with the weekend, students have February 12–15 off and are scheduled to return Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day in Indian River County in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Students have Monday, September 7, 2026, off for Labor Day. The district lists it as a holiday for students and employees.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day in Indian River County in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Students and teachers have Wednesday, November 11, 2026, off. The instructional calendar marks the date as no school for students and teachers without naming Veterans Day as the official reason.

faqs.question: What other single-day school closures should families know about?
faqs.answer: Outside the main breaks and conference closures, the calendar lists no classes on September 21, October 30 and November 11, 2026, and January 29 and April 23, 2027. Students are also off for Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18 and Presidents’ Day on February 15. January 4–5 are separate student-free days following the winter holiday.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to schools in Vero Beach, Sebastian and Fellsmere?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is the district instructional calendar for schools operated by the School District of Indian River County, including its schools in Vero Beach, Sebastian and Fellsmere. Charter schools, private schools and programs with separate schedules should be checked individually.

faqs.question: When are the 2026 back-to-school orientation dates?
faqs.answer: Elementary and K–8 school orientation is Wednesday, August 5; middle school orientation is Thursday, August 6; and high school orientation is Friday, August 7, 2026. The district calendar gives the dates, but families should check their school's notice for times and grade-specific arrangements.

faqs.question: When are the September 2026 school open houses?
faqs.answer: High school open house is September 15, middle school open house is September 16, and elementary and K–8 school open house is September 17, 2026. These events do not create districtwide days off.

faqs.question: When are the October 2026 parent-teacher conferences?
faqs.answer: High school conference night is Tuesday, October 20; middle school conference night is Wednesday, October 21; and elementary and K–8 conference night is Thursday, October 22, 2026. Friday, October 23, is a separate no-school day due to conferences.

faqs.question: When are the February 2027 parent-teacher conferences?
faqs.answer: High school conference night is February 9, middle school conference night is February 10, and elementary and K–8 conference night is February 11, 2027. Students have no school on Friday, February 12, following these conference nights.

faqs.question: Are schools open during the day on parent-teacher conference dates?
faqs.answer: Yes. The October 20–22, 2026, and February 9–11, 2027, conference nights do not replace regular daytime classes. Students instead have separate no-school days on October 23 and February 12.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists report cards on October 16, 2026, January 8, 2027, and March 19, 2027. It does not list a separate fourth-quarter report-card issue date.

faqs.question: When do the grading quarters end in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The first quarter ends October 9, 2026; the second ends December 18, 2026; the third ends March 12, 2027; and the fourth ends May 28, 2027. December 18 and May 28 are also modified instructional days. A quarter ending does not by itself mean students have the day off.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are scheduled for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar works out to 178 student attendance days. Its four printed quarter totals are 43, 42, 44 and 49 days, which add up to 178. This is a calculated annual total, not a separately printed annual figure. Modified instructional days are included.

faqs.question: What are the school hours for IR Prep in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The Parent Guide lists regular hours of 9:00 a.m. to 3:40 p.m., Eastern Time. It does not provide a modified-day dismissal time for IR Prep.

faqs.question: What are the school hours for Wabasso School in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Wabasso School's regular hours are 8:30 a.m. to 2:45 p.m., Eastern Time. The 2026–2027 Parent Guide does not list modified-day dismissal hours for this school.

faqs.question: Does the calendar list high school graduation or a separate seniors' last day?
faqs.answer: No. The instructional calendar lists May 28, 2027, as the final regular student day, but it does not provide graduation ceremony dates or a separate last day for seniors. Check your high school's announcements for those events.

faqs.question: Where can I get the official Indian River County 2026–2027 calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Use the official instructional calendar PDF linked on this page or visit the School District of Indian River County's Instructional Calendars page. The PDF is the district document to consult when checking holiday dates, conference nights and modified instructional days.

faqs.question: Can I add the 2026–2027 school dates to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. Download the .ics calendar file from this page and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or another compatible app. This is a static file, not a live district subscription, so imported dates will not automatically update if the district changes its schedule.

Families in Vero Beach, Sebastian and Fellsmere should treat these as planning dates until the district publishes an adopted calendar.

Orientation would take place August 5 for elementary and K–8 schools, August 6 for middle schools and August 9 for high schools. Open houses are proposed for September 14–16, with separate conference nights in October and February. The three October days off—October 11, 22 and 29—are separated by scheduled school days, so they do not form a full fall break. The draft also marks November 12, rather than November 11, as a day without classes.

Under the proposal, Thanksgiving break would run November 22–26. Winter Break is listed through January 3, with January 4 also student-free and classes returning January 5. Spring break would be March 20–24; March 13–17 remains a scheduled school week. Five modified instructional days are proposed for December 16–17 and May 24–26. Students would attend on those dates, but the draft does not give 2027–2028 dismissal times. May 26 would also be the final student day.

about.processing: Reviewed full extracted text and rendered calendar pages, including color legends and quarter counts. Keep school-level orientation, open houses and both conference-night sets; omit the staff duties printed on the same dates. Evening family events have no inferred attendance or dismissal change. Retain conference-related no-school days and in-year professional learning days that explicitly exclude students. Exclude staff-only preplanning/optional dates, employee-only holiday distinctions, post-year Memorial Day and June employee work. Each modified attendance date appears once, preserving grading endings and the last-day meaning together. No separately printed semester boundaries, progress-report dates, senior last days or graduation dates are inferred. Thanksgiving covers the full student week. Keep December winter range, January continuation and subsequent student-free dates as separate official events; combine them only in derived continuous break spans. January return is explicit; Thanksgiving, spring and February returns are inferred. Do not bridge the week of normal classes between the third-quarter ending and spring break. The draft first day comes from the orange August 10 grid marker and legend, not an absent sidebar caption. 43+41+45+49=178 is a derived proposal count; 209 weekdays minus 31 closures agrees. No current-year bell-time source is transferred. All events retain proposed status, and no approved public page or ICS is created.
about.updates: Current instructional-calendar folder entries, complete linked PDF files, available full News and Live Feed listings, the bell-time announcement and July Calendar Committee invitation reviewed October 19, 2026. The committee’s meeting dates are planning activity, not student closures. No later verified adopted replacement, emergency dismissal activation or dated attendance adjustment was found. PDF creation metadata and filename date strings are not used as approval, publication or revision dates. Rechecked October 23, 2026: both instructional calendar PDFs and the 2026-2027 Parent Guide were downloaded successfully and their SHA-256 hashes match the stored records. The calendar grid pages and Parent Guide page 13 were visually reviewed. The 2027-2028 PDF still bears its tentative/pending-approval marking, so draft status, nonindexability, proposed events, no public ICS and no transferred bell times are preserved. Updated SEO, Hero, three editorial paragraphs, FAQs and the specified event notes; normalized IR Prep and K–8 display spelling while preserving official labels, dates, attendance flags, classifications and source IDs. New document downloads do not establish a new Board approval or a later calendar revision. The proposed first-day key-date label basis is synchronized with the derived event name basis; its grid-derived official date remains unchanged. Second editorial review on October 23: updated SEO, Hero and editorial paragraphs; split the specified holiday and specialty-school FAQs and ordered questions around family planning needs. Parent Guide clock wording now consistently describes dismissal, not pickup or bus arrival. Added derived note provenance to the three specified draft explanations. No source verification timestamps or evidence levels were upgraded by these editorial changes; all dates, attendance flags, school-hours rows, calendar status and export eligibility are preserved.

faqs.question: Is the Indian River County 2027–2028 school calendar approved?
faqs.answer: The calendar currently linked by the district is labeled DRAFT, and the PDF is marked Tentative and pending approval. The dates shown here are proposals and may change.

faqs.question: When is the proposed first day of school in 2027?
faqs.answer: The draft marks Tuesday, August 10, 2027, as the first student day in its August calendar grid. This date is tentative and should not be treated as final until the district approves the calendar.

faqs.question: When is the proposed last day of school in 2028?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 26, 2028, is the proposed last student day. It is also marked as a modified instructional day and the end of the fourth quarter. Students would still attend on that date under the draft.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Indian River County in 2028?
faqs.answer: The draft schedules spring break for March 20–24, 2028. Including weekends, students would be away from regular classes March 18–26 and return Monday, March 27. March 13–17 remains a scheduled school week even though the third quarter ends March 10.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in the 2027–2028 draft?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is proposed for November 22–26, 2027. Including the surrounding weekends, students would have November 20–28 away from regular classes, with a scheduled return Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When is winter break in the 2027–2028 draft calendar?
faqs.answer: The draft lists Winter Break from December 20, 2027, through January 3, 2028, including the January 3 continuation. January 4 is a separate student-free professional learning day. With weekends included, students would have December 18–January 4 away from regular classes.

faqs.question: When would students return from winter break in January 2028?
faqs.answer: The draft specifically lists Wednesday, January 5, 2028, as the return date. Monday, January 3, is still part of Winter Break, and Tuesday, January 4, is a no-school day for students. The January 5 return is not yet an approved date.

faqs.question: Which modified instructional days are proposed for 2027–2028?
faqs.answer: The draft lists December 16 and 17, 2027, and May 24, 25 and 26, 2028. All five are proposed student attendance days, not holidays. December 17 ends the second quarter, and May 26 is the proposed final student day.

faqs.question: What time would schools dismiss students on modified days in 2027–2028?
faqs.answer: The available draft does not give 2027–2028 modified-day dismissal times. It also notes that dismissal may depend on emergency make-up needs. Do not assume the previous year's elementary, middle/K–8 or high school release times will apply.

faqs.question: Is there a full fall break in October 2027?
faqs.answer: No weeklong fall break is shown in the draft. Students would have October 11, October 22 and October 29 off, but regular school days separate those dates. Each closure remains subject to approval.

faqs.question: Is November 11 or November 12 a no-school day in 2027?
faqs.answer: The draft marks Friday, November 12, 2027, as no school for students and teachers. Thursday, November 11, is not listed as a school closure. This differs from the 2026–2027 calendar, so families should not carry over the previous year's date.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday, April 14, 2028?
faqs.answer: No, under the draft calendar. Friday, April 14, is marked as a day off for students and teachers. The district does not specify the reason for this closure, and the date remains tentative.

faqs.question: Is there school on Easter Monday, April 17, 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes, under the proposed calendar. Monday, April 17, is not marked as a day off, so classes are scheduled as usual. The calendar is still pending approval.

faqs.question: Would students have a four-day weekend in February 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes, under the draft. Students would be off Friday, February 18, due to conferences and Monday, February 21, for Presidents’ Day. This would create a February 18–21 break, with classes scheduled to resume Tuesday, February 22.

faqs.question: What other student holidays or closures appear in the 2027–2028 draft?
faqs.answer: Apart from the major breaks and conference-related days, the draft lists September 6, October 11, October 29 and November 12, 2027, and January 4, January 17, February 21 and April 14, 2028, without student classes. The reasons differ, so families should refer to the event details rather than treating them all as holidays.

faqs.question: Does the 2027–2028 draft apply to Vero Beach, Sebastian and Fellsmere schools?
faqs.answer: The proposal is for the School District of Indian River County's instructional calendar, covering its district-operated schools in those communities. Charter schools, private schools and programs with separate calendars should confirm their own dates. The districtwide proposal has not yet been approved.

faqs.question: What are the proposed 2027 back-to-school orientation dates?
faqs.answer: The draft lists elementary and K–8 orientation on August 5, middle school orientation on August 6 and high school orientation on August 9, 2027. School-specific times are not provided in the district calendar. All three dates remain tentative.

faqs.question: When are the proposed September 2027 open houses?
faqs.answer: High school open house is proposed for September 14, middle school open house for September 15 and elementary and K–8 school open house for September 16, 2027. These are school-level family events, not districtwide days off.

faqs.question: When are the proposed October 2027 parent-teacher conferences?
faqs.answer: The draft schedules high school conference night for October 19, middle school conference night for October 20 and elementary and K–8 conference night for October 21, 2027. Friday, October 22, is separately marked as a no-school day due to conferences.

faqs.question: When are the proposed February 2028 parent-teacher conferences?
faqs.answer: High school conference night is proposed for February 15, middle school conference night for February 16 and elementary and K–8 conference night for February 17, 2028. Friday, February 18, is marked as a separate no-school day due to conferences.

faqs.question: When are report cards scheduled in the 2027–2028 draft?
faqs.answer: The proposed dates are October 15, 2027, January 7, 2028, and March 17, 2028. The draft does not list a separate fourth-quarter report-card issue date.

faqs.question: When would the four grading quarters end in 2027–2028?
faqs.answer: The draft gives October 8 and December 17, 2027, and March 10 and May 26, 2028, as the four quarter-ending dates. December 17 and May 26 are also marked as modified instructional days. These dates remain tentative.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in the proposed 2027–2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: The four quarter totals printed in the draft are 43, 41, 45 and 49 days, adding up to 178 proposed student attendance days. This is a calculated total from a calendar that has not yet been approved.

faqs.question: Where can I view the Indian River County 2027–2028 draft calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: The School District of Indian River County lists the 2027–2028 draft in its official Instructional Calendars section. You can open the district's PDF using the link on this page. The document is still marked Tentative and pending approval.

faqs.question: Can I subscribe to or import the 2027–2028 calendar now?
faqs.answer: No public .ics calendar file is provided here for this tentative year. Use the linked draft PDF only as a planning reference, and check the district's official Instructional Calendars page for an adopted version before importing dates.
